## Goal

Fresh observation outside software: measure what happens to publicly stated unmet needs in a non-software domain, where the platform records the outcome

## Summary

Landed E058: a non-software need population read whole, and the instrument this record never had. 1200 rows over six non-software Stack Exchange sites; all 110 no-remedy rows classified. Of the 20 highest-arrival unremedied needs, a free general assistant answers 17 in full today, so 'the requester never came back' was never evidence a need went unserved (F091). G3's null branch is permanently disarmed because the rubric clause disqualified the treatment arm's ontology (F090, D082); the residual 5% is a record nobody kept (F092). Adopted view_count as the arrival measure (D083). No candidate, no prototype; one reusable instrument.

## Next

E059: run E058's answerability read against the mission's own 1401-row need corpus (2024-2026, 589 never-answered) with E058's 3 known-unresolved and 17 known-resolved rows as the instrument's positive and negative control, which closes the age gap E058 declared and decides whether the need-harvest route selects statements that are already served.
